draft.notice: Your draft stays in memory while this page is open. It is not saved to disk, not put in the address and is lost when you reload.

prefill.refused: These address parameters were not used because they are longer than {{limit}} characters: {{names}}.

fixed.label: Delivery settings that cannot be changed
fixed.mandatory: Mandatory is always on: if the broker finds no queue for this exchange and routing key, it returns the message and this page says so.
fixed.confirm: Publisher confirms are always on: each copy waits for the broker's confirm, or times out.

form.exchangeHint: Leave empty for the default exchange. The routing key is then the name of a queue.

headers.typedHint: Decimal, list and table values are typed as JSON. Bytes are base64.
headers.jsonHint: Each header is written as {"t": its type, "v": its value}.
headers.switchRow: A header needs fixing before the JSON can be shown. Fix the marked row first.
headers.switchJson: The JSON is not valid. Fix it before going back to the table.
headers.switchShape: The JSON is not a table of typed headers. Fix it before going back to the table.

body.label: Message body
body.highlightingNote: XML and YAML are coloured only; they are not checked.

editor.hint: Press Ctrl+M to let the Tab key leave the editor.
editor.fallback: The code editor could not be loaded, so a plain text box is used. Nothing is lost.

issues.summary: {{count}} to fix before this can be sent.
issues.invalidBase64: This is not valid base64 text.
issues.invalidJson: The headers JSON is not valid or is not a table of typed headers. Fix it or go back to the table.
issues.overLimit: The body is over the limit of {{limit}} bytes.
issues.tooDeep: Lists and tables can be nested at most {{limit}} levels.
issues.duplicate: Another header has the same name.
issues.badValue: This value does not fit its type.
issues.invalid: The message does not fit the publish contract.

send.label: Send
send.reading: Reading the environment of this connection before sending.
send.inFlight: A send is already in progress.
send.fix: {{count}} to fix before this can be sent.
send.failed: The engine answered with a failure. The details are on the page.

lock.locked: Locked. Changes that name this connection need an unlock first.
lock.reason: This connection is locked. Unlock it to send messages for 15 minutes.

dialog.title: Unlock {{name}}?
dialog.body: {{name}} is locked. Unlocking lets changes that name it go through for 15 minutes.
dialog.audit: The unlock is recorded in the audit log.

hint.capabilityMissing: This engine build cannot publish yet: no publish connection is wired. Nothing was sent and nothing was saved to the history.
hint.planRequired: The engine asked for a plan before it runs this publish, and this engine cannot show plans yet. Nothing was sent.
hint.planExpired: The plan is no longer valid. Send again to make a new one. The old plan sent nothing.
hint.gateBlocked: The engine refused because a rule is in the way. The reason above is the engine's. If it names an unlock, unlock the connection and send again.
hint.forbidden: Your login does not have the permission to publish on this engine.
hint.forbiddenBroker: The broker refused this connection's login for this exchange. Check the login of the connection and its permissions on the broker.
hint.notFound: The engine did not find something the send needs, such as the exchange or the connection.
hint.unreachable: The engine could not reach the broker. No confirm arrived.
hint.validation: The engine does not accept this message as it is. Read the detail above, fix the field and send again.

plan.title: Send this message?
plan.intro: The engine made a plan for this publish. It asks for the following before it runs.
plan.approvals: Approvals still needed: {{count}}. This page cannot grant them.
plan.closed: Send stays closed until everything above is given and nothing blocks it.

result.title: Result
result.notAll: {{confirmed}} of {{count}} copies confirmed by the broker. Read each copy below.
result.historyNotRecorded: The message was published, but this publish could not be saved to the history.
result.noUndo: A publish is a write: this page cannot take it back.

explain.confirmed: The broker confirmed this copy. What happens to it afterwards is not reported here.
explain.nacked: The broker refused this copy with a negative confirm. It was not accepted.
explain.returned: The broker returned this message to the publisher.
explain.returnedCode: The broker returned this message to the publisher (reply code {{reason}}).
explain.noRoute: The broker found no queue for this exchange and routing key, and returned the message to the publisher. The broker did not keep it for this publish.
explain.timeout: No confirm arrived in time. The broker may still have routed this copy.
explain.blocked: The broker blocked the connection, so nothing was sent for this copy.
explain.failed: This copy could not be sent. The code is the contract's error code.
explain.notSent: The send stopped before this copy, so it was not sent.
